correctness.rationale: The published 2026 outer-extremizer theorem applies to this bounded nontrivial functional. Taking an H² analytic root gives an exact coefficient expansion; Parseval bounds all higher coefficients by an explicit F_t. The global maximum exists interior for every t>2, and critical equations are equivalent to a quartic with exactly one positive root. The Schur quadratic criterion constructs a zero-free, norm-one extremizer, and equality in Parseval plus triangle inequality gives uniqueness modulo phase. Exact rational identity and deterministic numeric checks supplement the full analytic proof.

value.rationale: The endpoint evaluation norm of a degree-two Taylor section is a canonical operator norm in nonlocally convex Hardy spaces, with a genuinely coupled three-coefficient extremum. The theorem gives an all-exponent exact algebraic characterization and classifies every extremizer, which are not supplied by existing isolated-coefficient or two-jet theorems. The result is independent of an unproved higher-order extension and has a precise, naturally motivated invariant.
